findings.finding: Two separate visible keys and locks accompany closed private cabinet doors. Public table has open ledger, balance and closed assets box; three stools are empty and apparatus sits separately behind. No patient names are legible and no bodies are connected. Decorative marks do not establish anonymization, granted access, compensation or participant authorization; visibly hanging keys are staging, not verified separate custody. Dry front/left access reads clearly.

Exactly four worker/workbench views. First frame lacks rod, which appears in frame2; later tool/bracket geometry drifts, and final hand remains on pin rather than a hands-away stable finish. Gap appears in later rod views, but locking engagement is not mechanically established. Useful broad clamp/disconnect/lock gesture reference only, not exact tool instruction, safety certification or ready animation.

overall: Selected images remain usable as review concepts with explicit topology, mechanical and state-binding caveats. No certified runtime or consent/ending outcome.
